summary: Frontend-only verification of 3 targeted user-reported fixes: (1) removed the false 'Biraajo doesn't repeat a menu' / 'Not one menu.' copy on homepage Events section and /events archive, (2) added mobile spacing between the 3 chapter cards on homepage + /events archive, (3) removed the word 'scroll' from the homepage hero bottom hint, (4) added a new 'See the menu' hero button linking to the active chapter's menu page. Tested on mobile (390x844) and desktop (1920x1080). ALL fixes verified working.

verification_details.hero_scroll_word_removed: PASS - hero-section innerText no longer contains 'scroll'; bottom hint reads only 'a table set for stories'
verification_details.hero_view_menu_button: PASS - [data-testid=hero-view-menu-button] present, text 'SEE THE MENU', href '/menus/when-there-wasnt-enough'; click navigates correctly to the WTWE menu page
verification_details.hero_other_ctas_intact: PASS - hero-reserve-seat-button + hero-see-menu-button (Check out events link) still present
verification_details.homepage_events_copy: PASS - false claim 'doesn't repeat a menu' absent; new copy 'Every chapter runs its own menu, until the next one begins.' present
verification_details.homepage_mobile_card_gaps: PASS - vertical gaps of ~26px and ~42px between homepage-chapter-card-03/02/01 on 390px viewport; each card has its own border (visually distinct)
verification_details.archive_heading_copy: PASS - 'Not one menu.' removed; heading now 'A series of chapters, never repeated.'; description updated to 'Every chapter runs its own menu, until the next one begins.'
verification_details.archive_mobile_row_gaps: PASS - ~50px and ~26px gaps between archive-chapter-03/02/01 on mobile; individual borders present
verification_details.desktop_homepage_grid: PASS - 3 cards still side-by-side on 1920px (same y within 10px), tight editorial grid layout unchanged
verification_details.desktop_archive_layout: PASS - hairline divider between rows (1px measured); minor 25px gap between 02 and 01 attributable to framer-motion whileInView y:24 not yet settled at measurement time — visually the divide-y hairline layout is preserved

critical_code_review_comments: Hero.jsx: existing data-testid 'hero-see-menu-button' is applied to the /events 'Check out events' link, which is misleading naming (it points to /events not a menu). The NEW menu link uses 'hero-view-menu-button'. Consider renaming the /events link testid to 'hero-events-link' for clarity — not a bug, just a maintainability nit.

EventsArchive.jsx: motion.div with initial y:24 + whileInView causes ~25px visual gap on desktop between rows until animation completes. If a perfectly tight hairline-only layout is desired on desktop from first paint, consider disabling the motion offset at md+ or measuring after settle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 38 verified 3 targeted UX/copy fixes: removed 'scroll' word, added hero 'See the menu' button linking to active chapter menu, fixed false 'Biraajo doesn't repeat a menu' copy on both homepage Events section and /events archive, and added real mobile vertical spacing between chapter cards on both pages. Desktop grid layouts preserved. All prior iterations 34-37 flows (booking modal, gallery, video covers, dashes) not re-tested this round per E1 instruction.
